messages.en:
{07 05 00}WHAT?! I CAN'T HEAR YOU!
THE {ff 00 00 03}FIREWORKS SHOW{ff 00 00 00} JUST
STARTED!
{07 00 00}I CAN'T SEE ANYTHING AND
I'M GOING DEAF!
{07 0d 00}THIS TOTALLY ROCKS!
messages.et:
{07 05 00}MIDA?! MA EI KUULE SIND!
{ff 00 00 03}ILUTULESTIKUSHOW{ff 00 00 00}
ALGAS JUST!
{07 00 00}MA EI NÄE MIDAGI JA
JÄÄN KURDIKS!
{07 0d 00}SEE ROKIB TÄIEGA!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}{ff 00 00 03}Fireworks Shows{ff 00 00 00} are totally
manly, right?

{07 0e 00}It takes a real man to fill
a tube with power nuggets
of explosive goodness{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.
{07 06 00}And then{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 08 00}BAM!{01 01 00}
It's like the whole sky is
'sploding, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{ff 00 00 03}Ilutulestikud{ff 00 00 00} on täiesti
mehised, eks?

{07 0e 00}Tõeline mees suudab torusse
toppida vägevaid
plahvatusnuppe{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.
{07 06 00}Ja siis{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 08 00}PAUH!{01 01 00}
See on nagu terve taevas
plahvataks, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}This is the most intense
part of the {ff 00 00 03}Fireworks Show{ff 00 00 00}.

{07 15 00}It's like the two-minute
warning at the end of a
football game, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}See on {ff 00 00 03}ilutulestikushow'd{ff 00 00 00}
kõige intensiivsem osa.

{07 15 00}See on nagu kahe minuti
hoiatus jalgpallimatši
lõpus, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Me and fireworks have a lot
in common! Fireworks blow
up in the sky{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 05 00}And my biceps explode at
the gym, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Minul ja ilutulestikul on
palju ühist! Ilutulestik
plahvatab taevas{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 05 00}Ja mu biitseps plahvatab
jõusaalis, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}The fireworks are almost
over, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}. 

{07 14 00}But that just makes me
even more fired up about
'em!
{07 01 00}{01 08 00}{01 02 00}ROCK ON!{01 03 00}
{0b 03 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ilutulestik on peaaegu
läbi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}. 

{07 14 00}Aga just see ajab mu
selle pärast veel rohkem
hoogu!
{07 01 00}{01 08 00}{01 02 00}ROKI EDASI!{01 03 00}
{0b 03 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Today's fireworks are
almost over, but...

{07 15 00}Stay sharp 'til the end,{01 00 00 0a 00}
{ff 00 00 05}{04 1f 00}{ff 00 00 00}!

{07 19 00}The {ff 00 00 03}Fireworks Show
{ff 00 00 00}continues until you get
home safely, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Tänane ilutulestik on
peaaegu läbi, aga...

{07 15 00}Püsi lõpuni valvas,{01 00 00 0a 00}
{ff 00 00 05}{04 1f 00}{ff 00 00 00}!

{07 19 00}{ff 00 00 03}Ilutulestikushow
{ff 00 00 00}jätkub, kuni sa turvaliselt
koju jõuad, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 0d 00}Watching stuff blow up in
the sky just makes you
forget about your troubles.
messages.et:
{07 0d 00}Kui vaatad, kuidas asjad
taevas plahvatavad, unustad
oma mured ära.

messages.en:
{07 01 00}YES!!! Good game, buddy!
You were totally explosive
out there!
{07 0d 00}I'm all about cheering on
every firework when it
'splodes, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 01 00}JAH!!! Hea mäng, semu!
Sa olid seal täiesti
plahvatuslik!
{07 0d 00}Ma elan kaasa igale
ilutulestikule, kui see
plahvatab, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 03 00}Hah hah ha!


{07 0d 00}How'd they make that
firework look like an angry
linebacker, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?!
messages.et:
{07 03 00}Hah hah ha!


{07 0d 00}Kuidas nad tegid selle
ilutulestiku vihase
ründaja nägu, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?!

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Dude. Did you just say that
the {ff 00 00 03}Fireworks Show {ff 00 00 00}will be
over next week?
{07 01 00}What kind of a stupid
explosion-hater made up
that rule?!{01 00 00 05 00}
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Mees. Kas sa just ütlesid,
et {ff 00 00 03}ilutulestikushow {ff 00 00 00}saab
järgmisel nädalal läbi?
{07 01 00}Milline loll plahvatuste-
vihkaja selle reegli
välja mõtles?!{01 00 00 05 00}

messages.en:
{07 02 00}What?!{01 00 00 0a 00} Today's the last day
of the {ff 00 00 03}Fireworks Show{ff 00 00 00}?!

{07 08 00}But my life is meaningless
without colorful explosions,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00}

{07 00 00}When this {ff 00 00 03}Fireworks Show{ff 00 00 00} is
over, it won't happen again
for another YEAR?!
{07 15 00}What sissy made that
decision?!{01 00 00 14 00} We need MORE
explosions, not less!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Kui see {ff 00 00 03}ilutulestikushow{ff 00 00 00} läbi
saab, siis ei tule seda
enam terve AASTA?!
{07 15 00}Milline nõrguke selle
otsuse tegi?!{01 00 00 14 00} Meil on vaja
ROHKEM plahvatusi!
